segments.text:
Many of you were never Convinced to this day of your state of enmity against God, and without Conviction of this, reconciliation is impossible; without repentance there can be no reconciliation, and without Conviction there can be no repentance: when we repent we lay down our Weapons, Isai. 27. 4, 5. But how few have been brought to this? Alas! if a few poor cold heartless, ineffectual confessions of sin may pass for a due Conviction, and serious repentance, then have we been convinced, then have we repented: but you will find if ever the Lord intend to reconcile you to himself, your Convictions and humiliations for sin will be other manner of things: this will cost you more than a few cheap words against sin. 2 Cor. 7. 11. In that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of
your selves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge?
